originals.citation: Fjellstedt, N., & Sulzer-Azaroff, B. (1973). Reducing the latency of a child's responding to instructions by means of a token system. Journal of Applied Behavior Analysis.

quote: Fjellstedt and Sulzer-Azaroff (1973) used differential reinforcement of short latencies to decrease a child's latency to comply with instructions. We replicated this contingency with a young man diagnosed with Asperger syndrome
